Theme

Latin word

convenit

convenit (inter nōs)

impersonal use of conveniō: mihi cum aliquō, or inter aliquōs; with ut and the subjunctive

it is agreed (between us); we agree on; it is fitting, it is proper

In this lexicon

  • agree

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Capt. 378; Cic. Att. 6.1.14 (Lewis & Short)

  • appropriate

    also used · classical · Ter. Eun. 3.2.41 (Lewis & Short, s.v. conveniō)
